description: Encodes the last 12 observed frames as per-frame kNN player graphs (k=3, 1 GATv2 layers) and per-player temporal Transformers (1 layers), then predicts 8 future steps for each target player as a correction to constant velocity. Inputs exclude the ball landing point, charted labels, and outcomes.
name: Spatial-temporal trajectory model (GATv2 + Transformer)

trajectory.origin_rule: Forecasts start at the play's last observed frame, where the dataset's input window ends.
trajectory.uncertainty_note: Deterministic point forecast. The model outputs no uncertainty, so none is drawn.
